draft.subject: Following up on our North Ventures kickoff
draft.body:
Hi Zara,

Thanks again for making time for the kickoff last week. I wanted to follow up with one small next step while things are fresh.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting your first project in place is usually the thing that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and whenever you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you.

Best,
Nadia
